protocol.task: Observed first-appearance event click classification for training, fixed Top500 retrieval reranking for end-to-end validation
protocol.labels: action1=observed exposure/nonclick label0; action2=click label1; action3 unknown excluded; no random unexposed item negatives
protocol.statistics: Only per-user first half of original train prefixes contributes counts; second half yields training events; strict timestamp histories
protocol.training_sampling: Uniform at most12 eligible events per user, without label balancing or positive oversampling
protocol.point_validation: For original2000 validation users, first-appearance known events from original val_cut through strictly before test_cut; no test target scored
protocol.point_metric_scope: AUC/LogLoss on selected observed event cohort, not on unexposed retrieved candidates; not production CTR calibration
protocol.retrieval: Original validation-selected clickInfoNCE64 checkpoint per seed, frozen; full fixed catalog; exactTop500 with original history filtering; never inject target
protocol.ranker: Frozen q/user/item features plus 20 prior clicked ads,13 field matches and early statistics; residual score with positive recall skip
protocol.ablation: mean pool vs candidate-conditioned masked-softmax attention; same tensors/head initialization; DIN-inspired, not full original DIN reproduction
protocol.selection: Best end-to-end validation NDCG@10 thenHR@10 then earlier epoch; fixedepoch5 also reported; AUC secondary
protocol.test: Development-only reused validation; no test-target evaluation or main-model replacement
protocol.budget: Two variants by two seeds, five epochs; no architecture or blend grid
protocol.boundary: Per-user cutoffs and publicstatic catalog, no shared global-time cutoff; logged exposure selection bias remains
